text: {"fixed_clause": "The company reserves the right to process all applicant disclosures, including medical history, health conditions, and religious affiliations where provided, in accordance with applicable legal bases to support corporate wellness initiatives and internal operations, while ensuring that sensitive data is never processed on the basis of legitimate interest or used for marketing, and that health data access is strictly limited to those who need it."}

data.fixed_clause: The company reserves the right to process all applicant disclosures, including medical history, health conditions, and religious affiliations where provided, in accordance with applicable legal bases to support corporate wellness initiatives and internal operations, while ensuring that sensitive data is never processed on the basis of legitimate interest or used for marketing, and that health data access is strictly limited to those who need it.
